ui.title: Game · Yaga Labs
ui.stage: Yaga's farm. Tap the ground to walk there; tap with a tool to use it: dig, plant, water, harvest. WASD or the arrow keys walk, E or Space uses the tool in front of her, 1 to 7 pick a tool.

toolHint.hand: Hand: harvest ripe crops, pick up eggs, catch bugs. Tap the ground to walk.
toolHint.shovel: Shovel: tap grass or dirt to dig it into farmland.
toolHint.can: Watering can: water each crop once a day. Fill it at the well.
toolHint.seed:pumpkin: Pumpkin seeds: plant in dug soil. Ripe after 4 watered days.
toolHint.seed:cabbage: Cabbage seeds: plant in dug soil. Ripe after 3 watered days.
toolHint.broom: Broom: swat the pests that come for your crops at night.
toolHint.spell: Grow spell: a watered crop grows a day at once. Costs mana.

no.feed: No hen feed: buy some at the stall
no.water: The can is empty: fill it at the well
no.seeds: No {item} left: buy some at the stall

itemInfo.seed: Ripe after {days} watered days. Sells for {sell}.
itemInfo.feed: One scoop feeds one hen for a day. A fed hen lays an egg.
itemInfo.hen: You have {n} of {most}. Lays an egg each morning she is fed.

stall.title: Market stall
stall.nothing: Nothing to sell yet. Crops, eggs and bugs sell here.

goals.dig: Dig a plot with the shovel
goals.water: Water a crop with the can
goals.egg: Feed the hens, then collect an egg
goals.pest: Swat a night pest with the broom

bed.title: Go to bed?
bed.early: It's only {time}. Sleeping ends the day: watered crops grow, the soil dries, fed hens lay.
bed.late: Sleeping ends the day: watered crops grow, the soil dries, fed hens lay. Pests may still visit dry or ripe crops.

summary.title: Day {day}
summary.passedOut: You passed out at 2:00 and the Box dragged you home. Stamina {n}%.
earned: Yesterday you sold 1 thing for {coins} coins.
Yesterday you sold {n} things for {coins} coins.
eaten: A pest ate 1 dry or ripe crop in the night.
Pests ate {n} dry or ripe crops in the night.
dry: 1 crop was dry and didn't grow.
{n} crops were dry and didn't grow.
hungry: 1 hen went hungry: fill the trough.
{n} hens went hungry: fill the trough.
reverted: 1 bare plot turned back to plain ground.
{n} bare plots turned back to plain ground.

ui.nightPests: Night: pests are coming for dry or ripe crops. Broom: key 6.
ui.nightQuiet: Night. Every crop is watered: the pests will stay away.
ui.pestHint: A pest is going for your crops: take the broom (key 6) and tap it.
ui.resting: Out of stamina: resting {n} s. A night in bed fills it.
